thread:
Nina (People Ops): Quick post-all-hands thread for hybrid/office ops clarifications. I'll pin answers here.
Ethan (CTO): Thanks! Two quick ones: who signs cross-region offsite spend and can we ship laptops to offsite locations?
Nina (People Ops): Cross-region travel needs manager + finance partner approval. For shipping hardware, submit Equipment Travel Request and include serials + destination.
Rae (Eng): For small team retreats (<12 ppl) can we use a team card instead of everyone expensing? saves time.
Harper (Finance): Team card ok if under $2k and pre-authorized. For >$2k or any vendor invoice, we need a PO.
Sam (Recruiter): Contractors on extended engagements, are they eligible for travel reimbursement to join in-person sprints?
Nina (People Ops): Contractors on payroll >3 months and approved by manager can get travel reimbursed. Recruiting-managed interview travel is separate.
OfficeBot: Note: desk reservation window now 14 days. Same-day drop-ins allowed based on capacity.
Rae (Eng): Any guidance on Airbnb vs hotel for multi-night stays?
Harper (Finance): Hotels preferred for itemized invoices. Airbnb allowed if you can provide itemized receipt and host contact.
Nina (People Ops): We'll publish a one-page checklist (approvals, receipts, vendor visitors) by EOW and link it here. Drop other edge-case Qs and I'll add them. :thumbsup:
